# Golden fixtures

Copied unchanged from the app repo's `contract/fixtures/` on 2026-11-05: the set from commit
`39733d1` ("test(domain): golden fixtures for the backend, checked against the rules") regenerated
for down-first round order (every game now has `"order"` and `"schemaVersion": 4`, plus
`game-down-first.json`), taken from the app's working tree before that change was committed.
Generated by `EXPORT_FIXTURES=1 npx vitest run src/domain/fixtures.export.test.ts`.

Never edit these to make a test pass: refresh them from the app and report any mismatch to Jay.
